ci_support_linux_64_channel_sourcesconda:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge,conda-forge/label/python_rc
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.15.* *_cp315
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - python
  - channel_sources
name: oracledb
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: oracledb
  version: "26.0.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/oracledb-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d15728bae7546984203ae17f8296153d52d10ffdaf4929bebe46b70d5819d270

build:
  number: 1
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cython >=3.2,<4
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77.0.0
    - wheel
    - cython >=3.2,<4
  run:
    - python
    - cryptography >=3.2.1
    - typing_extensions >=4.14.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - oracledb
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Python interface to Oracle Database
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - NOTICE.txt
  homepage: https://oracle.github.io/python-oracledb
  repository: https://github.com/oracle/python-oracledb
  documentation: https://python-oracledb.readthedocs.io/en/latest/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - xylar
